units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 4. In sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) procurement, the contracting authority shall determine the contract price in accordance with this Federal Law. In the cases specified in paragraph 1(3), (6), (6.1), (11), (12), (16), (18), (19), (22), (23), (30)–(35), (37)–(41), (46) and (49) of this Article, it shall justify that price under this Federal Law and include the justification in the contract.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 5. Where supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful, a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) shall be concluded under paragraph 1(24) and (25) of this Article:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 1) on the terms specified in the procurement notice, where required by this Federal Law, and procurement documentation, where required by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 2) at a price not exceeding either the initial (maximum) contract price or the contract price offered by the participant, if this Federal Law requires the application to contain a price offer and/or provides for the participant to submit such an offer, or at the unit price of goods, works or services calculated under Article 51(2)(1)(в) of this Federal Law and the maximum contract price in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 3) in the procedure established by this Federal Law for conclusion of a contract with the winner of the relevant supplier (contractor, service provider) selection method, taking account of paragraph 9 of this Article. Where, during an electronic procedure or closed electronic procedure, procurement is made from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) under Article 52(8) or Article 77(4) of this Federal Law:
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: а) where Article 51 of this Federal Law provides for a participant to prepare and post information and documents on an electronic platform or specialized electronic platform, it shall prepare them, sign them with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post them in the unified information system, unless otherwise provided under this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: б) Article 51, paragraph 2(2), paragraph 3(2)(б), and paragraphs 6 and 7, of this Federal Law shall not apply;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: в) there is no limit on the number of records of disagreements that the participant may prepare, sign and post under Article 51(3)(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: г) in the case specified in Article 51(3)(2)(а) of this Federal Law, the record of disagreements shall identify the draft contract provisions in dispute instead of information in the draft that does not comply with the procurement notice requirements and the application’s provisions;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: д) the participant may prepare a refusal to conclude the contract, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it in the unified information system;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: е) the contracting authority may prepare a record of refusal to conclude the contract, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it in the unified information system. Instead of the application identification number, the fact constituting grounds for refusal and details of documents confirming that fact, the record shall state the grounds for the contracting authority’s refusal to conclude the contract;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 4) with approval from the procurement oversight body where a tender or auction has been declared unsuccessful and the initial (maximum) contract price exceeds the threshold or thresholds established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 6. Where approval of a sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract by the procurement oversight body is required under paragraph 5(4) of this Article, the contracting authority or the authorized body or institution vested with powers under Article 26 of this Federal Law shall send that body a request for approval no later than five working days from the date of:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 1) posting in the unified information system of the record stating that supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful, where that record must be posted in the system under this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 2) signing of the record stating that supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful, where that record is not to be posted in the unified information system under this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 7. A request for approval of a sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract shall be sent:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 1) for procurement for federal needs and where closed competitive methods are used, to the federal executive body authorized for procurement oversight or the State defence order oversight body;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 2) for procurement for the needs of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to that constituent entity’s executive body authorized for procurement oversight;
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 3) for procurement for municipal needs, to the local self-government body of a municipal raion, municipal district or urban district authorized for procurement oversight.
units.label: Point 3 Part 7 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 8. The procurement oversight body must examine a request for approval of a sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract within eight working days from the day following receipt. After examining the request and conducting an unscheduled inspection, it shall decide to approve the sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract or refuse approval.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 9. Where approval of a sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract by the procurement oversight body is required under paragraph 5(4) of this Article, the following requirements must be met:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 1) the period for the contracting authority to sign the draft contract shall run from the day following receipt of approval of the sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract by the contracting authority or authorized body or institution that submitted the request specified in paragraph 6 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 2) the contract may not be concluded before compliance with the order issued under Article 99(22)(2) of this Federal Law following an unscheduled inspection under Article 99(15)(4) of this Federal Law. If the order requires amendments to the draft contract, the contracting authority shall make them and send the amended draft to the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded, in the procedure established for conclusion of a contract with the winner of the relevant supplier (contractor, service provider) selection method;
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 3) the contract shall be concluded no earlier than ten days after the relevant record specified in paragraph 6 of this Article is posted in the unified information system or signed, and no later than twenty days after the contracting authority, authorized body or authorized institution receives approval of the sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract. It may not be concluded before that approval is received.
units.label: Point 3 Part 9 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 10. If the procurement oversight body refuses to approve a sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract, the supplier selection is declared unsuccessful. The contracting authority shall amend the procurement schedule if necessary and conduct a new procurement under this Federal Law if necessary.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 11. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish rules for approval by the procurement oversight body of a sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract in the case provided for in paragraph 5(4) of this Article, providing, in particular, for:
units.label: Part 11 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 1) the procedure for submitting a request for approval and requirements for its composition, content and form;
units.label: Point 1 Part 11 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 2) the procedure for the procurement oversight body to examine the request and the grounds for approving the sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract or refusing approval;
units.label: Point 2 Part 11 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 3) the procedure for sending a decision approving the sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract or refusing approval.
units.label: Point 3 Part 11 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 12. In the cases provided for in paragraph 1(4)–(5.2) of this Article, procurement for an amount not exceeding five million roubles may be conducted electronically using an electronic platform, resulting in a contract for goods or for granting a right to use computer software and/or a database, including updates and additional functionality, including through remote access over information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet (also referred to in this paragraph as goods). The annual volume of procurement in this manner must not exceed one hundred million roubles. Procurement of goods under this paragraph shall follow this procedure:
units.label: Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 1) to participate in procurements under this paragraph on an electronic platform, participants may prepare on the platform, sign with an enhanced electronic signature and post on it a preliminary offer to supply goods (hereinafter, a preliminary offer), containing, for each item offered:
units.label: Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: а) the name and characteristics of the goods, using the catalogue of goods, works and services for State and municipal needs;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: б) the trademark, if any;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: в) the country of origin of the goods;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: г) information and documents determined under Article 14(2)(2) of this Federal Law. In their absence, the goods shall be treated as originating in a foreign State;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: д) the unit of measurement according to the All-Russian classification used for quantitative assessment of technical, economic and social indicators;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: е) the unit price or prices, taking account of delivery costs, taxes, levies and other mandatory payments, and of the quantity offered and the constituent entity or entities of the Russian Federation, municipal raion or raions, municipal district or districts, or urban district or districts within whose territory the participant offers to supply the goods, as specified in subpoints “ж” and “з” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: ж) the minimum and/or maximum quantity offered for supply. The quantity may be specified by reference to the constituent entity or entities of the Russian Federation, municipal raion or raions, municipal district or districts, or urban district or districts in whose territory supply is offered, as specified in subpoint “з” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: з) the name of the constituent entity or entities of the Russian Federation, municipal raion or raions, municipal district or districts, or urban district or districts within whose territory the participant offers supply, according to the All-Russian classification or classifications used for comparability and automated processing of information by administrative-territorial division, and for systematic and unambiguous identification of municipalities and their localities throughout the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: и) the validity period of the preliminary offer, which may not exceed one month from its posting on the electronic platform. The participant may extend its validity or withdraw it at any time before the electronic platform operator sends the application to the contracting authority under point 5(в) of this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: к) the information and documents specified in Article 43(1)(1), subpoints “н”–“п”, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «к» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: л) the minimum delivery time or times and/or maximum delivery time or times, taking account of the quantity offered and the constituent entity or entities of the Russian Federation, municipal raion or raions, municipal district or districts, or urban district or districts in whose territory supply is offered, as specified in subpoints “ж” and “з” of this point. These delivery periods shall be calculated in calendar days and stated in calendar days in the preliminary offer. Failure to state minimum or maximum delivery periods under this subpoint signifies the participant’s agreement to the delivery period in the procurement notice under point 3(в) of this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «л» Point 1 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 2) posting a preliminary offer under point 1 of this paragraph signifies the participant’s consent to the electronic platform operator sending contracting authorities offers for goods meeting the requirements of procurement notices under point 3(в) of this paragraph. The participant is responsible for the accuracy of the information and documents in the preliminary offer and their compliance with Russian legislation. The preliminary offer shall be deemed a procurement application submitted by the participant from the time the operator performs the action specified in point 5(а) of this paragraph. The participant may amend the preliminary offer in the procedure established by point 1 of this paragraph for preparing and posting it. Such amendments shall apply to participation in procurements whose notices are posted in the unified information system after those amendments are posted on the electronic platform;
units.label: Point 2 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 3) the contracting authority shall use the unified information system to prepare a procurement notice, sign it with an enhanced electronic signature and post it in that system. The notice shall contain:
units.label: Point 3 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: а) the Internet address of the electronic platform;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: б) the information specified in Article 42(1)(1)–(3), (9), (10), (13), (15), (17), (18) and (24) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: в) the name and characteristics of the goods using the catalogue of goods, works and services for State and municipal needs; the initial unit price including delivery costs, taxes, levies and other mandatory payments; the quantity to be procured; the unit of measurement according to the All-Russian classification used for quantitative assessment of technical, economic and social indicators; and the delivery period and place, using the All-Russian classification or classifications for comparability and automated processing of information by administrative-territorial division and for systematic, unambiguous identification of municipalities and their localities throughout the Russian Federation. The delivery period shall be calculated and stated in the procurement notice in calendar days;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: г) information on the possibility of unilateral refusal to perform the contract under Article 95(8)–(23) and (25) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 3 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: д) the requirements for procurement participants provided for in Article 31(1) and (2) of this Federal Law, where applicable;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 3 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: е) the requirement established under Article 31(1.1) of this Federal Law, where applicable;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 3 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 4) the procurement notice provided for in point 3 of this paragraph must contain the draft contract and justification of the sole-supplier contract price. The notice may not be amended;
units.label: Point 4 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 5) within one hour of the procurement notice being posted in the unified information system, the electronic platform operator shall, taking account of point 8 of this paragraph and using the platform:
units.label: Point 5 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: а) select, from all preliminary offers posted under point 1 of this paragraph, no more than five procurement applications (preliminary offers) that meet the procurement notice requirements under point 3(в) and (е) of this paragraph and contain the lowest unit prices for the goods being procured. Applications shall not be considered if the participant lacks an unblocked quantity of goods, after blocking under subpoint “г” of this point, equal to the quantity to be procured specified in the notice under point 3(в) of this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 5 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: б) assign each application specified in subpoint “а” of this point an identification number and a rank in ascending order of the unit price specified in point 1(е) of this paragraph. The application with the lowest unit price shall be ranked first. If several applications have the same unit price, the application from the participant that posted its preliminary offer for those goods earlier under point 1 of this paragraph shall receive the lower rank number. If only one application is selected under subpoint “а” of this point, it shall be ranked first;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 5 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: в) send the contracting authority the applications specified in subpoint “а” of this point, indicating the ranks assigned under subpoint “б” of this point and containing the information and documents specified in point 1, subpoints “а”–“е” and “к”, of this paragraph and Article 43(6)(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 5 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: г) where the participant states a maximum quantity in its preliminary offer under point 1(ж) of this paragraph, block, from the quantity stated under that subpoint in the preliminary offer of each participant whose application is sent under subpoint “в” of this point, the quantity to be procured specified in the procurement notice under point 3(в) of this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 5 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 6) no later than one working day from the day following receipt of the information and documents specified in point 5(в) of this paragraph, the contracting authority shall:
units.label: Point 6 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: а) decide for each application whether it meets the procurement notice requirements or must be rejected for failure to provide the information and documents specified in point 5(в) of this paragraph, for their non-compliance with the notice, or in the cases provided for in Article 48(12)(3)–(6) and (8) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 6 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: б) on the basis of decisions under subpoint “а” of this point, rank each application not rejected in ascending order of the unit price specified in point 1(е) of this paragraph, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law. The application with the lowest unit price, or the only application not rejected under subpoint “а” of this point, shall be ranked first;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 6 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: в) use the electronic platform to prepare the record of supplier selection results, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and send it to the platform operator. Within one hour of receipt, the operator shall post it in the unified information system and on the platform, and also post in the system, without publication on the official website, the information specified in Article 43(1)(1), subpoints “а” and “е”, of this Federal Law, the application identification numbers and the register entry numbers of participants whose applications were sent to the contracting authority under point 5(в) of this paragraph. The record must contain the date the results were determined, application identification numbers, information on decisions under subpoint “а” of this point and, where an application was rejected, the reasons, specifying the application’s provisions and the provisions of this Federal Law and the procurement notice with which it does not comply, and the information specified in subpoint “б” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 6 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 7) the contract shall be concluded with the participant whose application is ranked first, in the procedure established by Article 51 of this Federal Law, subject to the specific rules in Article 50(6) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 7 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 8) if no applications meet the procurement notice requirements under point 3(в) and (е) of this paragraph, the electronic platform operator shall, within the period specified in point 5 of this paragraph, notify the contracting authority that there are no applications and post that notification in the unified information system;
units.label: Point 8 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 9) where a participant whose application was sent to the contracting authority under point 5(в) of this paragraph states a maximum quantity in its preliminary offer under point 1(ж) of this paragraph, the electronic platform operator shall, no later than one hour after:
units.label: Point 9 Part 12 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: а) posting of the record of supplier selection results under point 6(в) of this paragraph, release the quantities blocked under point 5(г) of this paragraph for all participants except the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded under this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 9 Part 12 Art. 93
